request.spec:
A name or alias may no longer be used on a sheet when any sheet of its tree (its ancestors, its
descendants and their descendants, among the sheets that exist) already uses it as a name or alias:
adding, renaming, an alias, the quick-add bar, the paste box (and any later import) are refused as a
duplicate would be. People who already clash are not changed: each shows clashing yes, and every
edit of them through the person form is refused until the edit renames them to a name that does not
clash (and leaves no clashing alias).
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A name or alias may no longer be used on a sheet when any sheet of its tree (its ancestors, its
descendants and their descendants, among the sheets that exist) already uses it as a name or alias:
adding, renaming, an alias, the quick-add bar, the paste box (and any later import) are refused as a
duplicate would be. People who already clash are not changed: each shows clashing yes, and every
edit of them through the person form is refused until the edit renames them to a name that does not
clash (and leaves no clashing alias).

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
A sheet now refuses a name or alias that any other sheet in its tree already uses. The tree is the sheet's parent chain plus all its descendants. `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests.

**What changed**
- **Finding the tree:** `Settings.tree(sheet)` returns the other sheets in the tree: ancestors (following the parent setting) and descendants.
- **The check:** `People` gained `usedInTree` (is this name or alias used on another sheet in the tree, ignoring case) and `aliasClashes` (does one of this person's aliases clash).
- **What's refused:**
  - Adding a person, and quick-adding a new name, are refused like a duplicate.
  - Adding an alias is refused the same way.
  - Paste already refused any name that isn't a person on the current sheet, so it needed no change.
- **People who already clash:** they are left as they are. Every person now has a `clashing` value, shown in a new **Clashing** column (`person-clashing`, showing yes/no).
- **Editing through the person form:** an edit is refused while the name being saved clashes or any of the person's aliases clash. A clashing person can only be saved once the edit gives them a name that doesn't clash and none of their aliases clash. A refused edit writes nothing and leaves no audit record.
- **Help text:** the person form's error message now mentions the tree rule.

**Choices you may want to revisit**
- **Bulk grade is not blocked.** The new edit check covers only the person form, so the bulk grade action still changes clashing people. The request only mentioned the form, and the scenario 3 test bulk-grades people.
- **Transfer is not checked against the tree.** Moving a person to another sheet still checks only that sheet, because the request didn't list transfers.
- **"Any later import":** the app has no import feature, so this part of the request had nothing to apply to yet.
